title: Book Three · Chapter 69: The Place on the Map
story:
Leo's eleventh reply arrives during the next week.

Ronan reads it after school. Mum is measuring a coat near the window. Outside, the wind moves a loose corner of Mr Qiu's cloth.

Leo writes about his own winter. The bus windows are wet in the morning. His aunt gives him an extra piece of bread because the journey feels longer in the cold.

Then he asks about the deliveries.

Do the oranges reach home? I know you. My aunt says a shop visit can take longer near food.

Ronan smiles. He did tell Leo about the orange for Mum.

The next part is quieter. Leo likes the new school now. He also wants to see more places. His friend has family in another city and talks about it often.

I don't know where I will work yet. Here is not the only place. But my aunt wants this week's homework first.

Ronan puts the letter down.

Anna has a city name in her book. Leo has more than one place in mind too. Ronan looks at the little envelope on his shelf.

It holds enough for some local bus rides. It will not pay for a long visit and several nights away.

Mum finishes a line on the cloth and puts down her tape.

“Good news?”

“Mostly.”

“The other part?”

Ronan turns the letter over in his hands.

“He doesn't know where he will work. I don't know either.”

“At fifteen?” Mum asks.

He looks up. She is smiling a little.

“Anna wants to learn about buildings in another city.”

“That is something to find out about.”

“It may be far.”

Mum folds the measured cloth.

“Far needs plans and money. Looking at a book doesn't buy a ticket.”

Ronan nods. He takes Leo's old address paper from his birthday book and unfolds it.

The city name is familiar now. He has written it many times, but he still cannot picture all the streets.

At dinner, he asks Dad to show him the place on a map. After the meal, Dad brings out a small road map from his papers.

They find their own city first. Then they find Leo's.

Ronan follows the space between them with one finger. Dad turns the map so both names face Ronan.

“A journey,” Dad says.

“Not this week.”

“No.”

Ronan studies the roads for a few minutes. Then he folds the map along its old lines and gives it back.

He puts the address inside his book again. On a clean sheet, he writes one question to Leo about the new streets. The rest of the page can wait until he has finished tonight's work.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

extra＝额外的；local＝本地的；in mind＝心中想到的；road map＝道路地图。

## 理解问题

1. Leo是否已经确定将来留在哪个城市工作？这让Ronan想到什么？
2. 看地图是否代表一家已经买票安排出行？本章实际做到了哪一步？

## 读句子

**Dad turns the map so both names face Ronan.**

拆开看：Dad / turns the map / so both names face Ronan.

Dad／转过地图／让两个城市名都正对Ronan。
